subject: Reference sprint: short one-pagers & customer soundbites
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reference sprint: short one-pagers & customer soundbites

Team —

We're building a concise set of sales-ready assets for the Q3 playbook (one-pager, 2-slide summary, and 3-4 short soundbites per customer) and need a small collection of customer references we can ship to GTM by May 8. Ask is below: 

- Can you each surface 1-2 customers who are happy to provide: 1 short (20–40 word) quote, 1 metric we can share publicly (latency, cost reduction, throughput improvement), and permission to use logo.
- Preferred asset: single-page case summary (use attached example-onepager.pdf as a style guide).
- Deadline: May 8 COB. If a full one-pager is hard, 2–3 bullets + a 20–40 word quote and a logo is fine.

Marissa — can you prioritize customers in your pipeline that have recent runtime/latency wins? Vivek/Tessa — please flag any legal or compliance requirements up front (logo/legal check).

I'll draft the outbound language for the ask and share a one-pager template.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: example-onepager.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reference sprint: short one-pagers & customer soundbites

Sounds good — quick list from my side: 

- Olive Labs — Amy Chen (amy@olivelabs.com). We implemented the dedicated routing policy in March; they saw a 3x throughput improvement on peak.
- Nimble Retail — Carlos Jimenez (carlos@nimble.com). Lowered per-token cost after Redwood Optimize changes.

I'll open outreach to Amy this afternoon and attach the MAP we've been using to align on permissions. Sharing the MAP I drafted (MAP_OliveLabs_v1.xlsx). If Rachel wants to review the draft email before I send, ping me.

-Marissa
Account Exec
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_OliveLabs_v1.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@olivelabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: quick quote + one-pager for Redwood case study

Hi Amy —

I'm Rachel on the go-to-market team at Redwood Inference. Marissa recommended we reach out — Olive Labs' deployment with our dedicated routing looked great in the Q1 reports. We're assembling a short set of customer one-pagers and 20–40 word soundbites for our Q3 sales playbook and would love to feature Olive Labs with your permission.

Would you be willing to share the following?

1) A short quote we can use in marketing (20–40 words) about the experience or impact of Redwood.
2) One public metric we are allowed to share (e.g., throughput increase, latency reduction, cost delta).
3) Permission to feature Olive Labs' logo on a one-page case study (we can send a logo usage form if needed).

If it's easier, a couple of bullets + logo are totally fine — we can produce the one-pager from that. Attached is a very short one-pager template to make it easy (one-pager-template.docx). If you prefer, Marissa can walk through the MAP she uses to align on permissions; I'm happy to draft the copy and run it by legal before it goes live.

Would you be able to respond by Tue May 4? If there's someone else on your team who should be looped in for approvals, please let us know.

Thanks so much, and happy to jump on a 15-minute call if that's easier.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Amy Chen <amy@olivelabs.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: quick quote + one-pager for Redwood case study

Hi Rachel & Marissa —

Happy to help — thank you for the clear ask. Here are the pieces you can use publicly: 

Quote (use as-is): "Redwood's dedicated routing cut our peak inference latency by two-thirds and made real-time features reliable for our customers."
Metric: "~67% reduction in median tail latency during Black Friday window."
Logo: we are fine with you using the Olive Labs horizontal logo; attaching for your assets folder. Our legal team asks that we get a quick approval view before anything goes on the website.

If you want me to sign a short permission statement, I can do that. Otherwise this is fine for the one-pager.

Best,
Amy Chen
Head of Platform
Olive Labs

Attachments: olivelabs-logo.png (attachment stub)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: quick quote + one-pager for Redwood case study

Nice — Amy gave us a clean quote and permission for the logo (legal wants an approval screenshot before site use). Marissa, I'll build the one-pager from her bullets and the template and share the draft for Amy/Legal sign-off. Vivek/Tessa — flag anything we can't publish and I'll hold until we have sign-off.

Plan:
- Today: draft one-pager + two-slide summary (Rachel)
- Wed: internal review + legal check (Tessa)
- Thu: send to Amy for final quick sign-off (Marissa/Rachel)

Thanks team — almost there.

Rachel
Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
